# Atharva Mahamuni · Android Developer & IFE Systems

> Atharva Mahamuni is an MTS-2 Android Developer at Panasonic Avionics in Pune, India, with 4+ years of professional experience specializing in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Clean Architecture, and embedded seat-back In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) systems.

## Core Expertise
- **Android & IFE**: Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, ViewModel, Navigation, ExoPlayer / Media3 video playback, seat-back display systems, Bluetooth LE.
- **Architecture**: Clean Architecture, MVVM, Repository Pattern, SOLID principles, Modular multi-module Gradle setups.
- **Concurrency & Data**: Kotlin Coroutines, StateFlow / SharedFlow, RxJava, Retrofit, Room SQLite, Dagger Hilt.
- **Build & CI/CD**: Gradle Kotlin DSL, Version Catalogs, Fastlane, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions.

## Professional Experience
- **Panasonic Avionics Corporation** (Pune, India):
  - MTS-2, Android Developer (Jul 2026 – Present)
  - MTS-1, Android Developer (Jan 2025 – Jul 2026)
  - Engineered seat-back IFE apps across a fleet of 10 premium aircraft.
  - Architected a shared Clean Architecture Android framework across 3 product lines.
- **Capgemini** (Pune, India) · Client: **National Stock Exchange**:
  - Associate Consultant, Android Developer (Oct 2022 – Jan 2025)
  - Built internal performance and load-testing Android applications for NSE.
  - Biometric authentication, Android Keystore security, Baseline Profiles.
